nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Mimo Code session source, re-exporting the history-reading submodule.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Shared building blocks for all 'imported history' sources (Claude Code, Cline, Cursor, OMP, etc.): the generic ImportedHistoryLoader adapter, activity-chunk construction helpers, edit-impact computation, and common text/timestamp normalization.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryLoader
nodes.summary: Generic SourceAdapter implementation parameterized by a source's discover/load/candidate-paths functions, shared across all imported-history sources.

nodes.name: ImportedHistorySessionRow
nodes.summary: Row shape for a single imported-history session as returned in a paginated session list.

nodes.name: ImportedHistorySessionPage
nodes.summary: Paginated page of imported-history session rows with a next-page cursor.

nodes.name: ImportedHistorySidebarRow
nodes.summary: Row shape for a session as shown in the date-grouped sidebar, including impact metadata.

nodes.name: ImportedHistorySidebarPage
nodes.summary: Paginated, date-bounded page of sidebar rows.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryRecentPath
nodes.summary: A recently touched source path paired with its session id, used for fast change detection.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryRowInput
nodes.summary: Input shape used to construct an ImportedHistorySessionRow or sidebar row from cached data.

nodes.name: ImportedToolCall
nodes.summary: Canonical representation of a single tool invocation and its resolved output within a session's activity.

nodes.name: imported_history_loader
nodes.summary: Constructs an ImportedHistoryLoader SourceAdapter wired to a specific source's discover/load functions.

nodes.name: load_activity_chunks_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads the full ordered list of canonical activity chunks for a cached imported-history session.

nodes.name: effective_limit
nodes.summary: Clamps a requested page-size limit to the source's allowed maximum.

nodes.name: page_from_rows
nodes.summary: Builds a paginated page result plus next-cursor from a list of rows and the requested limit.

nodes.name: row_from_input
nodes.summary: Converts an ImportedHistoryRowInput into a full ImportedHistorySessionRow.

nodes.name: recent_paths_from_rows
nodes.summary: Extracts ImportedHistoryRecentPath entries from a list of cached session rows.

nodes.name: recent_paths_from_paths
nodes.summary: Builds ImportedHistoryRecentPath entries directly from a list of filesystem paths.

nodes.name: strip_internal_context_blocks
nodes.summary: Strips orgii's internal injected context blocks from message text before display.

nodes.name: user_message_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical user-message activity chunk.

nodes.name: assistant_message_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical assistant-message activity chunk.

nodes.name: thinking_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical model-reasoning ('thinking') activity chunk.

nodes.name: tool_call_chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical tool-call activity chunk from a call and its resolved output.

nodes.name: impact_from_edit_chunks
nodes.summary: Aggregates file-edit impact stats (files touched, lines added/removed) from a session's edit chunks.

nodes.name: edit_chunk_failed
nodes.summary: Determines whether an edit chunk represents a failed edit attempt.

nodes.name: collect_edit_paths
nodes.summary: Recursively collects file path values referenced anywhere within an edit payload.

nodes.name: find_string
nodes.summary: Finds the first string value among a list of candidate keys in a JSON object.

nodes.name: collect_patch_paths
nodes.summary: Collects file paths referenced by a diff/patch payload.

nodes.name: insert_touched_path
nodes.summary: Inserts a path into a touched-files set, normalizing it first.

nodes.name: count_patch_lines
nodes.summary: Counts added/removed lines in a unified-diff patch string.

nodes.name: nonempty_line_count
nodes.summary: Counts the number of non-empty lines in a block of text.

nodes.name: parse_iso_to_epoch_ms_opt
nodes.summary: Parses an optional ISO-8601 timestamp string into epoch milliseconds, returning None on failure.

nodes.name: normalize_created_at
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw created-at value (numeric or string) into an ISO-8601 timestamp.

nodes.name: epoch_ms_to_iso
nodes.summary: Converts an epoch-milliseconds timestamp into an ISO-8601 string.

nodes.name: repo_name_from_path
nodes.summary: Derives a short repository display name from a filesystem path.

nodes.name: truncate_name
nodes.summary: Truncates a display name to a maximum length, adding an ellipsis if shortened.

nodes.name: paths.rs
nodes.summary: Path and signature utilities shared by imported-history sources: path de-duplication and file/SQLite-sidecar signature computation for change detection.

nodes.name: dedupe_paths
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate paths from a list while preserving order.

nodes.name: file_metadata_signature
nodes.summary: Computes a change-detection signature from a file's size and modification time.

nodes.name: sqlite_sidecar_signature
nodes.summary: Computes a change-detection signature for a SQLite database, including its WAL sidecar file if present.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Reads and caches Mimo Code session history from its local SQLite database, converting rows into imported-history cache inputs and delegating transcript parsing to the shared opencode-compatible history reader.

nodes.name: MimoCodeSessionMeta
nodes.summary: Parsed metadata row for a single Mimo Code session read from its local database.

nodes.name: list_mimo_code_history_sessions_paginated
nodes.summary: Lists cached Mimo Code sessions in a paginated page for the sidebar.

nodes.name: list_mimo_code_recent_paths
nodes.summary: Returns the most recently touched Mimo Code session paths for change detection.

nodes.name: load_mimo_code_history_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads full history for a single Mimo Code session id.

nodes.name: sync_mimo_code_history_cache
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the Mimo Code session cache by discovering, parsing, and upserting all local session records.

nodes.name: list_session_meta_from_conn
nodes.summary: Reads session metadata rows from an open Mimo Code database connection.

nodes.name: meta_signature
nodes.summary: Computes a change-detection signature for a Mimo Code session metadata row.

nodes.name: container_parent_ids
nodes.summary: Builds a map of container ids to their parent session ids from a list of session metadata rows.

nodes.name: meta_to_cache_input
nodes.summary: Converts Mimo Code session metadata into the cache input shape used by the imported-history cache layer.

nodes.name: source_id_from_session_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the underlying Mimo Code source session id from a canonical session id.

nodes.name: open_mimo_code_db_at
nodes.summary: Opens the Mimo Code SQLite database at a given path in read-only mode.

nodes.name: mimo_code_history_candidate_paths
nodes.summary: Enumerates candidate on-disk database paths for discovered Mimo Code sessions.
